thousandsons/rules/army_rules/Cabal of S:
Condition: your Army Faction = THOUSAND SONS
Timing: start of your Shooting phase
Restriction: Ritual attempts optional for one or more of your models with this ability
Select: 1 such model, no Ritual attempted by it this turn
1 Ritual from list below, no attempted manifestation by your army this turn
Result: selected model takes Psychic test using sequence below

Psychic Test Sequence
Roll 2D6
optionally **Channel the Warp**
then, if any doubles or triples rolled: D3 mortal wounds suffered by testing model's unit
if testing model survives: sum of all test dice = Psychic test result
result ≥ attempted Ritual's Warp Charge: Ritual manifested by testing model, effects resolved

**Destiny’s Ruin** (Psychic)
1 enemy unit selected, visible to manifesting model and ≤24" from it
for each attack targeting selected unit by your THOUSAND SONS or SCINTILLATING LEGIONS models
Hit roll of 1: re-roll
Psychic test result 10+: optionally re-roll Hit roll instead
until end of phase

**Temporal Surge** (Psychic)
1 friendly THOUSAND SONS or SCINTILLATING LEGIONS unit selected
visible to manifesting model and ≤24" from it
selected unit outside Engagement Range of all enemy units
selected unit: optional Normal move, up to D6"
Psychic test result 10+: optional Normal move, up to 6" instead
in either case, selected unit ineligible to declare charge until end of turn

**Doombolt** (Psychic)
1 enemy unit selected, visible to manifesting model and ≤24" from it
Lone Operative units excluded if both outside any Attached unit and >12" from manifesting model
selected unit: D3 mortal wounds suffered
Psychic test result 11+: D3+3 mortal wounds instead

**Twist of Fate** (Psychic)
1 enemy unit selected, visible to manifesting model and ≤24" from it
for each attack targeting selected unit by your THOUSAND SONS or SCINTILLATING LEGIONS models
attack's Armour Penetration improved by 1
Psychic test result 12+: Armour Penetration improved by 2 instead
until end of phase
